margin_formula.GE_or_GT: m=(x-t)/d, where d is the exact positive denominator stored on that component row
margin_formula.LE_or_LT: m=(t-x)/d, where d is the exact positive denominator stored on that component row
margin_formula.exclusive_source: Every per-member component margin, gate minimum, maximin value, Pareto comparison, ECDF knot, failure-set diagnostic, checker recomputation, and summary statistic must use the denominator on the component row and the identical exact_denominators_by_component map; the two representations must match exactly.

margin_formula.zero_rule: GE and LE are inclusive and pass iff m>=0.0. GT and LT are strict and pass iff m>0.0. Both +0.0 and -0.0 compare as zero: inclusive passes and strict fails. NaN or infinity is a technical integrity failure.

margin_and_joint_diagnostics_contract.maximin_margin: The binary64 minimum of the five gate margins in frozen gate order; equivalently the minimum of all 17 component margins. It is descriptive only and cannot rank, select, retry, or promote a member.

pairwise_gate_failure.jaccard: J[i,j]=|F_i intersect F_j|/|F_i union F_j|; define J=1.0 when the union is empty. Emit symmetric exact 5x5 count, rate, union-count, and Jaccard matrices.

uncertainty_contract.general_one_sided_upper_formula: u95(k,N) = BetaQuantile(0.95; k + 1, N - k) for 0 <= k < N, and 1 for k = N

uncertainty_contract.interval: two-sided exact Clopper-Pearson for every reported gate and pattern probability; the primary zero-count diagnostic additionally reports the one-sided exact upper bound
uncertainty_contract.model: independent Bernoulli indicators under the frozen reference population

weighting_contract.failed_member_weighting: forbidden because any failed member closes the run without an estimator
weighting_contract.member_weight: exactly 1/768 for every one of the 768 prespecified members
